page_title: AST 3-1 BRE | Aston Villa v Brentford 04/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
90+5' A rebound falls kindly for Vitaly Janelt (Brentford), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
90+4' Aston Villa are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
90+1' Lewis Smith has a clear sight and sees a foul from Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa).
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
90' Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) fires a powerful shot which is blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Aston Villa can continue in their attacking effort.
89' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
88' Unai Emery has decided to make a change. Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) replaces John McGinn.
87' That will be all from Morgan Rogers who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa).
86' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

86' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Mark Flekken guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
84' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mark Flekken intercepts the ball.
82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Matty Cash (Aston Villa) was quite harsh and Lewis Smith didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
80' A substitution has been made. Keane Lewis-Potter is replaced by Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford).
79' Emiliano Martinez leaps to intercept the corner kick from Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford).

79' Fabio Carvalho (Brentford) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Brentford are going to take it.

77' Tyrone Mings (Aston Villa) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just over the bar. Unlucky! The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
76' The referee blows his whistle, Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.

76' Mark Flekken pulls off a great save to deny Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Aston Villa.
75' One of the Brentford players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
73' Igor Thiago (Brentford) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar.
71' Substitution. Yoane Wissa makes his way off the pitch and Igor Thiago (Brentford) comes on as his replacement.
70' Thomas Frank has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fabio Carvalho (Brentford) replacing Kevin Schade.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Boubacar Kamara trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ross Barkley (Aston Villa).
67' Some great controlled play and passing from Aston Villa. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
65' Lewis Smith shows a yellow card to Jhon Duran (Aston Villa), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
65' Here is a change. Ollie Watkins is going off and Unai Emery gives the last tactical orders to Jhon Duran (Aston Villa).
65' Substitution. Leon Bailey walks off the pitch and Jaden Philogene (Aston Villa) comes on as a substitute.
64' It is time for a substitution. Paris Maghoma (Brentford) is on for Yegor Yarmolyuk.
64' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
63' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
63' A pass into the penalty area from Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is intercepted by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Brentford are awarded a corner kick.
61' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 14:4. The shots on goal statistics – 8:1.
60' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
59' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

58' What a wasted opportunity by Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Mark Flekken makes a decent save to thwart him. Aston Villa get a corner.
57' Lewis Smith blows his whistle and signals a foul after Yoane Wissa (Brentford) brought his opponent down.
54' 3 - 1 Goal! Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top of the net. He makes it 3:1.
54' Aston Villa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

54' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the left side of the goal. Mark Flekken displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
52' Aston Villa are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
49' Today's referee Lewis Smith rightly decides to book Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) for his harsh tackle.
49' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

48' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear. Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

47' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) whips in a cross from the corner, but Mark Flekken is well positioned and punches the ball away. The linesman makes the right call and Aston Villa will have a corner.

47' What a sweet touch by Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) as he collects a pass. From near the edge of the box he produces a shot which goes towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to thwart him!
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' The free kick from close range, taken by Brentford, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

45+3' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Lewis Smith stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Brentford are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
45+2' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
45+2' Some patient build-up play from Brentford as they look to unlock the defence.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' A free kick into the box, taken by Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa), is comfortably cleared by the opposition's defence.
44' The current number of shots on goal is 6:0.
43' The corner is swung in but Aston Villa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

43' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the roof of the net. Mark Flekken is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him. Aston Villa win a corner.
41' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) plays a through ball but overhits it.
40' The Aston Villa players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
38' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
34' 3 - 0 Goal! Matty Cash (Aston Villa) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:0.
34' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 52:48.
33' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
31' Brentford hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
28' 2 - 0 Goal! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Mark Flekken to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
28' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
28' Referee Lewis Smith is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Aston Villa!
26' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Aston Villa using VAR. Let's see what happens.
25' Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Lewis Smith ignores the protests.
25' Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Joy for one side, despair for the other as the referee gives a penalty to Aston Villa!
21' 1 - 0 An excellent first touch by Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa), who collects a splendid pass and from the edge of the box slams the ball into the top right corner!
17' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
16' Lewis Smith blows his whistle and it's Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

15' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Mark Flekken pulls off an easy save.
13' The referee blows his whistle as Kevin Schade (Brentford) was too aggressive in his challenge.
12' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
12' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
9' The Brentford players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
7' The corner from Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) is intercepted by Emiliano Martinez.

6' Kevin Schade (Brentford) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Brentford.
5' Lewis Smith blows the whistle, Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) is penalised for a foul.
2' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
1' The first half has just begun.
Brentford will kick the game off.
Lewis Smith got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
